messages:
Maya L.: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Carlos R. for sprinting down to the kitchen at 9:30 and rescuing the coffee cart when the bean hopper jammed. Saved our Monday demos :coffee: :tada:
Carlos R.: lol team effort. I used the secret allen key trick from ops manual. No one punch code required :sunglasses:
Sasha N.: also props for the plant CPR. I found the basil wilted and Carlos revived it with a mister, miracle hands :seedling:
Jordan K.: can we get a "Coffee Cart Hero" sticker? will pay in snacks :stuck_out_tongue:
Emily T.: +1 on stickers. Also, Carlos — can you teach me the mister technique? my cactus is judging me
Maya L.: vote poll: sticker or plaque? react with :star: for sticker, :medal_sports: for plaque
OpsBot: Poll opened by Maya L. — react to cast vote. Poll ends in 48h.
Jordan K.: :star:
Sasha N.: :star: (and free biscotti for Carlos?)
Carlos R.: :medal_sports: only if plaque fits on coffee cart :grin:
Emily T.: :star: (for the cactus rehab workshop)
Maya L.: Thanks y'all. Tiny things like this keep the office magic alive. Tagging @carlos in the kudos thread and adding to our 'wins' board :sparkles:
Carlos R.: blushing, thanks everyone. Happy to run a mini coffee-cart maintenance 101 next week — bring questions and pastries.
